name: ANSI/IEEE Touch-sensitive switch form
summary: IEEE-library form of touch-sensitive switch: a touch-switch representation identifies operation by the documented touch-sensing mechanism.
description: This reference locates touch-sensitive switch in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented touch switches family. A touch-switch representation identifies operation by the documented touch-sensing mechanism. The public library uses HPX1TS for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.
